items.headline: 奈及利亞集體婚禮的難題
items.context: 奈及利亞有一項集體婚禮方案，幫付不起結婚費用的伴侶完成終身大事。但主辦方碰上新難題——怎麼分辨真心相愛的情侶，和想混進來撈好處的詐騙者。
items.thread_text:
奈及利亞的集體婚禮方案，是為付不起結婚費用的伴侶設計的——在當地，結婚的開銷相當可觀。但方案也碰上難題：報名的人之中混著想藉機撈好處的詐騙者，主辦方得想辦法分辨誰是真心的戀人、誰是騙徒。

本則來自 BBC 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的報導。

items.headline: 法國野火究責數百人被捕
items.context: 法國七月遭遇規模空前的野火肆虐，政府正在追究責任，至今已有數百人被逮捕。但火到底該怪誰，報導本身也打了個問號。

items.headline: Nas 倫敦演出走懷舊路線
items.context: 紐約饒舌傳奇 Nas 在倫敦水晶宮碗形劇場登台，與 The Roots 同場演出——這是美國老牌音樂節 Roots Picnic 第一次移師倫敦。樂評形容他重現九零年代的經典，狀態懷舊。
items.thread_text:
紐約饒舌傳奇 Nas 在倫敦水晶宮碗形劇場（Crystal Palace Bowl）登台，與 The Roots 同場——這是美國辦了近二十年的音樂節 Roots Picnic 第一次移師倫敦。樂評形容 Nas 這場走懷舊路線，演出九零年代的經典作品，還聊起 1994 年第一次來倫敦的往事——那正是他發行經典專輯 Illmatic 的年代。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的樂評。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Crystal Palace Bowl, London Nas performs his gritty but intricate 90s classics, sharing the bill on the first London edition of the Roots Picnic festival with Questlove and co’s exuberant funk Looking out over the audience at the Crystal Palace Bowl, Nas feels moved to reminisce about his first visit to London. It was in 1994, around the time he released his landmark debut album Illmatic ; he remembers performing on pirate radio stations and “eating good Jamaican food”. It seems unlikely that he ever thought he’d be back in the capital sharing the stage with a man playing a sousaphone, but such is the power of the Roots Picnic, a US institution for nearly 20 years. Its famously eclectic bill has regularly featured great rappers backed by hip-hop’s premier live band, sousaphone player and all: Lil’ Wayne, the Wu-Tang Clan, Snoop Dogg, Jay-Z. Before Nas appears at the festival’s first London iteration, the Roots play their own set, augmented by a guest appearance from Common. It plays out almost as one long medley which shifts restlessly between their own back catalogue and old funk, soul and disco covers. They do a killer version of James Brown’s The Payback. Awesomely tight, driven by the relentless crack of drummer Questlove’s snare and heavy on jazzy brass solos, it’s a perfect demonstration of the unique musical space they’ve carved out over the years, somewhere between hip-hop and jam band: the Grateful Dead of rap, if you like. items.headline: Lucy Beaumont 歌單告白
items.context: 英國喜劇演員 Lucy Beaumont 分享私人歌單：四、五歲愛上同樣來自赫爾的 The Housemartins，第一張買的單曲是麥可傑克森的 Thriller。至於 Coldplay，她說主唱人看起來很好——但音樂讓她想暈車。
items.thread_text:
英國喜劇演員 Lucy Beaumont 攤開自己的歌單：第一首愛上的歌是四、五歲時聽的 Caravan of Love，唱的 The Housemartins 跟她一樣來自赫爾（Hull）；第一張買的單曲是麥可傑克森的 Thriller。至於 Coldplay——她說主唱 Chris Martin 人看起來很好，但他們的音樂讓她想暈車。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的訪談。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: As a tween, Hull’s finest learned the rap from Waterfalls – now she blubs to prog. But which song from a British singer-songwriter is her guilty pleasure? The first song I fell in love with Caravan of Love by the Housemartins, when I was four or five. They’re also from Hull, but I think I mainly liked it because my granny and grandad had a caravan in their garden that I used as a wendy house. The first single I bought I remember buying Thriller by Michael Jackson from HMV in Hull, even though it was before my time. Everyone loved Michael Jackson so I was probably copying somebody at school. Continue reading...

items.headline: 愛丁堡藝穗節前輩傳心法
items.context: 愛丁堡藝穗節期間，一群喜劇老將把生存心法傳給第一次登台的新人——怎麼面對緊張、負評、賣不出票。受訪者包括五十多歲才開始說單口的 Fiona Allen，和六十多歲首次參加藝穗節的老牌藝人 Joe Pasquale。

So we paired a few up with veterans to talk past mistakes, coping strategies – and the odd celebrity encounter Binge on the fringe: the must-see shows at Edinburgh 2026 Explore the rest of our coverage of the Edinburgh festival 2026 Everyone has to start somewhere – even at the Edinburgh festival fringe. But what made Smack the Pony actor Fiona Allen take up standup in her 50s? Why is veteran TV entertainer Joe Pasquale making his fringe debut in his 60s in an ensemble comic play? How many taboos will newcomer Sepideh Kaav, a Berlin-based Iranian comic in her early 30s, break by talking about sex? items.headline: 中國電動車歐洲賣到新高
items.context: 中國電動車在歐洲的銷量衝上新高，今年進口車已占市場的 14%。義大利買氣大增、英國關稅偏低是主因，也讓「傾銷」的指控和提高關稅的呼聲再度升溫。
items.thread_text:
中國電動車在歐洲的銷量創下新高，今年進口車已占市場 14%。強勁需求、英國的低關稅，加上義大利買家大增，是這波成長的主因。同時，「中國車廠拿國家補貼傾銷」的指控聲浪也在升高，這些數字讓要求配額與提高關稅的呼聲更有力了。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:
中國電動車，在歐洲賣出了歷史新高。今年以來，進口的中國電動車已經占下歐洲市場的 14%。需求強是一個原因，英國的低關稅是另一個，義大利的買家也明顯變多。但同一時間，指控也跟著來——有聲音說，這些拿國家補貼的車是在歐盟和英國「傾銷」，歐洲車廠需要配額和更高的關稅來保護。這些銷售數字，讓提高關稅的呼聲更有力了。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
